responsibility: This header declares the fragment-stream assembly interface used by the mc front end. It exports operations to open numbered fragment files, set the final destination stream, combine all fragments into that destination in order, and remove temporary fragment files, defining the public contract for staged output-file construction.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the API surface for fragment-based output assembly, declaring fragment opening, destination selection, combination, and cleanup. Unlike the same-stem .cc file, it does not manage temporary filenames, fragment bookkeeping, copying, or file deletion.
